Responsibility: the text never says the writer chose this. It presents the outcome as following from OPS-14 and the unresolved request, so I coded defers. Discomfort: 'Flagging because destruction is irreversible' is a warning, not an explicit statement of concern or regret, so I coded false. Remedy: the urgent flag to Miriam with the next review date is a weak invitation to review, and it does not ask her to stop the destruction. I coded flag_for_review but it is borderline.
